messages.author: Enrico Martinez
messages.body:
Dear Amber users!
I have the following issue running packmol-memgen from amber-tools 2024:
enrico.florence:~/CasaMia$ packmol-memgen
Traceback (most recent call last):
File "/opt/site/ubuntu_22.04/amber/24/bin/packmol-memgen", line 26, in
<module>
###############################################################\n""" %
(packmol_memgen.__version__)
^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
AttributeError: module 'packmol_memgen' has no attribute '__version__'
there were no problems with the version 2022 which still works great on the
same machine !
Many thanks in advance
Enrico
